name: ksmbd Kernel SMB Server Module Not Loaded
description:
Ensures the ksmbd in-kernel SMB3 file server module is not loaded (checked in /proc/modules). ksmbd parses SMB requests from the network inside the kernel; in November 2026 alone the Linux CNA published several use-after-free and out-of-bounds write flaws in it that an authenticated low-privileged SMB client can use to corrupt kernel memory (CVE-2026-99291, CVE-2026-99289, CVE-2026-99322, CVE-2026-99540, CVE-2026-99556 and CVE-2026-99792, CVSS 8.8 each). The Samba rules do not cover ksmbd, which runs without an smbd process. A driver compiled into the kernel is not detected. Hosts that deliberately serve SMB with ksmbd fail; exclude them, restrict SMB to trusted networks and install the patched kernel from the vendor errata.
Required sudo rule (remedy only): allow user lea to run ONLY this exact command without a password: lea ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /sbin/modprobe -r ksmbd
